title: Locomamba: Vision-driven locomotion via end-to-end deep reinforcement learning with MAMBA
core_idea: Introduce Locomamba, a vision-driven end-to-end deep reinforcement learning framework for quadrupedal locomotion that uses the selective state-space model MAMBA as a cross-modal fusion backbone. Proprioceptive states are embedded via an MLP and depth images are patchified by a CNN into spatial tokens tailored for MAMBA-based fusion, enabling immediate state estimates and look-ahead while reducing appearance sensitivity. Stacked MAMBA layers fuse proprioception and depth via selective state-space scanning to achieve near-linear time and memory scaling, long-horizon modeling, robustness to token length and image resolution, and a regularizing inductive bias. The policy is trained end-to-end with PPO on MAMBA-fused features, combined with terrain and appearance randomization, an obstacle-density curriculum, and a compact state-centric reward balancing progress, energy efficiency, and safety.
tldr: Locomamba is an end-to-end vision-driven DRL framework that fuses proprioception and depth with a selective state-space MAMBA backbone to enable efficient, foresightful quadrupedal locomotion control.
